items.caption: A seal-style drawing of 木, the tree or wood element in the traditional analysis of 樣.
items.alt: Black seal-style 木 graph on a white background, with a central vertical stroke and curved branches.
items.selection_reason: Shows the semantic component identified in the historical dictionary account; it is a modern redraw, not a dated specimen of 樣.

items.caption: A seal-style drawing of 羕, the phonetic element in the traditional analysis of 樣.
items.alt: Black seal-style 羕 graph on a white background, with a complex upper form and flowing lower strokes.
items.selection_reason: Illustrates the traditional phonetic graph and distinguishes it from 羊 in standardized 样. The drawing itself does not establish the history of 樣.

limitations.text: These are modern seal-style redrawings of components, not images of 樣 or dated artifacts. They cannot establish the compound’s earliest form or a chronological sequence of its graphic changes.
The 1956 scheme establishes 樣 as the traditional counterpart of standardized 样, but the reason 羕 is replaced by 羊 in 样 is undocumented in the cited evidence.
